name: Haus Sonnenhang
beschreibung: The Haus Sonnenhang welcomes visitors to an exceptional sunny hillside vantage point in Sölden in the Ötztal, commanding fascinating panoramic views across the valley floor and glaciated alpine summits. Styled with authentic Tyrolean wood accents, the inviting guest rooms and holiday flats feature modern en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies or terraces. In the morning, a generous breakfast buffet laden with regional produce provides energy for mountain adventures. The elevated setting ensures complete peace and quiet while keeping Sölden's centre and cable car terminals within easy reach. In winter, the nearby ski bus connects directly to the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl gondolas. In summer, varied hiking and biking routes begin right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy bed and breakfast in a sunny hillside position in Sölden in the Ötztal with panoramic summit views and close to cable cars.
